dict.string: Request microphone access to transcribe audio locally
Felix records the other people on a call (the audio your Mac plays) when you record a meeting. It stays on your Mac.
Felix reads who's invited to the event a meeting is recorded in, to put names to the voices. It only reads, and nothing leaves your Mac.
